summary: Feed s178_triple is degraded: 3 faults detected for NDR - 17.4% one-way TCP sessions (needs both directions), 24.39 Gbps microburst overloading 10 Gbps port (244% capacity), and 93.9% encrypted share exceeding 90% tolerance. Requires bidirectional aggregation, load balancing, and decryption/mirroring strategy.

findings.root_cause: 93.9% of bytes are encrypted vs 90% NDR tolerance. Modern TLS-everywhere environment renders payload opaque; NDR cannot perform deep packet inspection without decryption or TLS metadata enrichment.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR detection coverage reduced: payload signatures, exploit detection, and data exfiltration analysis fail on encrypted flows, leaving only flow/metadata analysis.

recommended_fix.why: NDR needs_full_payload=true but payload is opaque. Decrypt at packet broker via key sharing or forward copy to decryption zone, or at minimum enrich with JA3/SNI/cert metadata to restore detection without breaking privacy policy.

findings.root_cause: 17.4% of TCP sessions (82 of 470) show only one direction, above 10% threshold. Indicates asymmetric routing or packet broker forwarding only one side of flow (e.g., client->server without return path) - incomplete bidirectional aggregation.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs_both_directions=true to reconstruct TCP state and track handshakes. One-way flows break session reassembly, cause missed C2/lateral movement detections and false scan alerts.

recommended_fix.why: Configure packet broker to aggregate both directions of each 5-tuple to same NDR port using symmetric hashing, ensuring complete session visibility for stateful NDR analysis.

findings.root_cause: Peak microburst of 24.39 Gbps in 1ms interval vs 10 Gbps NDR port (244% of capacity, 1 overloaded interval). Aggregated feed bursts exceed single tool port buffers, causing NIC-level drops.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR will silently drop packets during bursts - exactly when high-volume attacks, exfiltration or DDoS occur - creating blind spots and degrading detection fidelity despite broker showing no drops.

recommended_fix.why: NDR needs full payload so slicing/filtering would hurt coverage. Load-balance across 3x10G ports (or 2x25G) with flow-aware hashing to absorb 24+ Gbps bursts without loss.
